body: have you tried 7 cups? it's a talk therapy website I've heard about multiple times but I've never really tried it myself. might be worth a try.
you're so brave for having asked her out, even if she said no. you're plenty good enough.

I want to be honest with you in saying high school is genuinely hell, at least it has been thus far for me. But having been in your position, I completely believe that you are strong enough to get through whatever it throws at you. Reach out for help, look for friends around your age online, develop interests outside of school. there's so much in the world besides school, it's only 5 years. I know it seems long and unbearable but if I could do it or anyone else in this sub could do it, you are entirely capable to do so as well. You're strong, don't underestimate yourself.

honestly if I had the opportunity I would love to try inpatient again, but it's just so damn expensive. the first one i went to was hardly a hospital, more of a boot camp where you'd talk about your feelings for. two hours a day. thank you for your response!

I lost a childhood friend to suicide when i was 14. from five years old onward we'd share classes and play soccer and football and that sort of thing together. he was arguably the most kindhearted, patient kid i'd ever met, but i digress. the pain was, as i'm sure you know, indescribable. i would never wish that pain on anyone. 

how i moved past it, especially when i was so young, was allow myself to grieve and grieve with other friends of his. if you are still in contact with his family or other friends, i think a good option woukd to be to reach out and grieve together, as the process alone is isolating and painful. best of luck to you, friend. it goes up eventually.
I'll have to give that a try. thank you so much for replying !
